steps.content: The bump on your head is throbbing with pain, but you have no time to waste. Trying to remember Nightingale's last instructions, you start to act.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The elevator will take you to the Bureau's real <color=#fb9259>restricted area</color>. Turn right after exiting the elevator. Get to the end of the third corridor and go down two floors.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Avoid anyone who is not a prison guard. If you hear anyone, hide in the nearest cell under the blanket. That woman has removed all restraints, so the cell doors will be open.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You want to get to the middle section of Area B-3, where you will find <color=#fb9259>the only prisoner who voluntarily</color> stays in the cage. Find <color=#fb9259>her</color>. Her number is...
This way! This way, Sir!

steps.speaker: Girl in Cell
steps.content: A-are you the new guard?  I... I'm <color=#fb9259>Hella</color>.
steps.female_content: A-are you the new guard? I... I'm <color=#fb9259>Hella</color>.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm not like those baddies. See? I didn't cause any trouble, nor did I try to escape.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But I'm scared... Those baddies are so scary. They... they wanted to kill me! They said they would come back to kill me later!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sir, can you let me out, please?
steps.female_content: Ma'am, can you let me out, please?

steps.content: Is she the person you're looking for? You step back to survey this cell.

The lock on the cell door has clearly been damaged violently by a blunt object. The warning "<color=#fb9259>Unlock Failed</color>" flashes on the smashed screen—and a bent steel pipe is hidden at the young girl's feet.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Th-those baddies smashed it. I didn't do it. Trust me, Sir. Please let me out. I...
steps.female_content: Th-those baddies smashed it. I didn't do it. Trust me, Ma'am. Please let me out. I…

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I've begged you so many times! Are you gonna let me out or not?!!

The young girl reveals her true fierce self. Her hand reaches out of the cell and yanks you by the collar towards her. She is incredibly strong, hitting you against the glass and trapping your neck from behind with the cold steel pipe.
Observing with great difficulty, you can see sparks splash onto her white arm and create a burn, which, however, heals immediately.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't go against me, little guard... My power isn't to be messed with, and <color=#fb9259>Sinners</color> aren't prisoners you can trap.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I don't have time to play with you. Before I count to five, open the door, or I'll strangle you!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Aaahhh—!!
A shadow suddenly dashed out before your eyes, then Hella screamed behind you and the pipe fell to the ground with a clang.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...You bastard!
